name: ElevenLabs Voice
description: Official ElevenLabs AI voice and speech synthesis plugin. Generates realistic MP3 audio ready to play, download, and share in chat.
author: Chattree Core Team
changelog: 1.1.0: Added structured intentContract (speak, config, status, disconnect, help), expanded voice catalog with custom voice_id support, whitespace-tolerant JSON parsing with \uXXXX decoding, proper JSON body escaping, dynamic MP3 filenames, real API error extraction, and English minimalist Chattree UI.

tools.description: Official ElevenLabs text-to-speech integration. Output ONLY a single valid JSON object with no extra text. For action='speak', provide 'text' (exact speech content in the user's requested language, max 4500 chars), optional 'voice' ('george', 'sarah', 'rachel', 'adam', 'antoni', 'josh', 'elli', 'sam', or a 20-char ElevenLabs voice_id), optional 'model', and optional 'filename'.

intentContract.description: Interpret the user's natural-language ElevenLabs request and return ONE valid JSON tool call only.

fields.name: action
fields.description: Action to perform: 'speak' (synthesize text to MP3), 'config' (save ElevenLabs API key), 'status' (check saved API key), 'disconnect' (remove saved API key), or 'help' (show usage and voices).

fields.name: text
fields.description: Exact speech text to synthesize for action='speak' (max 4500 chars, without meta-commentary).

fields.name: voice
fields.description: Optional voice name ('george', 'sarah', 'rachel', 'adam', 'antoni', 'josh', 'elli', 'sam', 'male', 'female') or a 20-char ElevenLabs voice_id.
